answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an oasis bet on surviving 110 epochs of grading, and every jade settlement recomputes the knoll schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 110 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
